noah: hey folks — just joined today. quick asks: is there a recommended channel naming convention i should follow when creating a new topical channel? also, what's the preferred flow for bug reports vs feature asks vs casual convos? and bots are spamming me, how do i quiet them?
welcome-bot: 👋 Welcome Noah! Start with #new-hires for intros. For channel naming we use kebab-case, team prefixes (e.g., #eng-platform), feature channels (#feature-<name>), and temporary channels as #temp-<topic>. See handbook: https://intranet.redwood.com/handbook/channels
marta (People Ops): quick rules: intros -> #new-hires or #random for casual. Bugs -> #help or the service channel; include a minimal repro. Feature asks -> #product-feedback or the relevant product channel. Private HR/payroll -> DM People Ops.
ash (Eng): for technical issues paste a minimal repro in the root of the thread, e.g.:
```
Service: ingest-api
Env: staging
Cmd: curl -X POST https://ingest/api -d '{"x":"y"}'
Observed: 500 Internal Error (trace=abc123)
Expected: 200 with JSON body
```
Then keep follow-ups in-thread. For PR reviews post the PR link + 1-line summary in your team channel.
leo (DevEx): bot controls: mute per-app via App Settings > Notifications, or use slash commands: `/ci digest on`, `/ci mute me`, `/deploy snooze 8h`. Onboarding bot: `/onboard subscribe` and `/onboard pace slow`. We recommend setting global notifications to "Only mentions" to reduce noise and relying on threads for context.
noah: thanks! when should i bump a thread vs start a new one? and what's the rule for @channel vs @here?
marta (People Ops): bump once after ~24-48 hours if no response. Start a new thread when the subject changes. @channel = only for truly urgent channel-wide items; @here = people online now but still use sparingly.
ash (Eng): if a thread gets long (>~10 replies) and becomes a design convo, summarize and create a doc/issue, then start a linked thread for the doc. That keeps channels scannable and searchable.
leo (DevEx): emoji shorthand: :eyes: = looking/acknowledged, :thumbsup: = approve/ack, :white_check_mark: = resolved. Use reactions instead of replies for quick acks. Pin important docs (canonical) and use bookmarks for ephemeral links (meeting notes, deploy links). Add a one-line description when pinning.
ci-bot: [ci] build #5123 failed on linux/integration - https://ci.redwood.com/build/5123
noah: perfect — also quick policy Q: if i have a security concern, DM or channel?
marta (People Ops): DM Eng Security or drop into the private #sec-private channel. Never post security-sensitive details publicly.
noah: thanks everyone — i'll keep threads tidy, mute non-critical bots, and follow the naming conventions. :smile:
